pretreatments.description: Thermal hydrolysis at 110 °C using electric mode. This involved a temperature increase by electric mode, allowing a temperature increase by electric mode. The process, used for thermal pretreatment, allowed us to compare performances obtained in electric mode against performances obtained in steam mode that is generally used at industrial scale.

Thermal hydrolysis at 165 °C using electric mode. This involved a temperature increase by electric mode, allowing a temperature increase by electric mode. The solubilisation of COD and VS were chosen to evaluate the degree of disintegration of pretreated sludge. The solubilisation was expressed as a percentage, following the equation: S X ( % ) = S S − S S 0 X p 0 × 100 where S _S and S S 0 are the concentrations in soluble fraction, measured in treated and untreated sludge, respectively; X p 0 is the concentration in particulate fraction, measured in untreated sludge.
